title: Read Whole Surahs
tagline: Put everything together, verse by verse, in twelve short surahs.
intro: You now know the rules. This level has you read twelve complete short surahs, one verse at a time, with every color in play. These are the surahs most people memorize first, so you will be reciting them for years: this is where your tajweed becomes a habit.

lessons.title: Surah Al-Fatihah
lessons.summary: Read Surah Al-Fatihah one verse at a time and spot every color you have learned.
explain: Watch for the silent lam in ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ, the madd on stopping at several verse ends, and the deep-navy necessary madd in ٱلضَّآلِّينَ.
Take each verse in turn: look, say it aloud, then reveal the card and listen. Repeat until it flows.
how: Read each verse slowly and aloud.
Let the colors remind you of the rule.
Flip the card and compare with the reciter.
tips: Start slowly. Speed comes from accuracy.
